_about: The relit mode's per-level choices ([Graphics] rt_relit, engine/gfx/rt_relit.h), built into the exe; thug2-decomp-relit.json beside the exe (the same layout) adds to them and wins. Each level by its scene's name: "relit": false keeps the level's bake, "strength": 0 - 1 its own blend, "sun": "level" keeps its baked sun under rt_sun_source=game (every effect's sun - engine/gfx/rt_scene.h scene_sun - where the game's sun looks wrong there). A level whose bake shows no sun (the Foundry) keeps its bake without an entry.
